rows.note: This is the usual spoken choice for personal loyalty or devotion to a person, group, or organization.

example.english: I have a lot of loyalty to this company.
example.traditional: 我對呢間公司好有忠心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 zung1 sam1

rows.note: Use this as the broad, all-purpose equivalent, especially in more formal or abstract contexts.

example.english: Loyalty is the foundation of trust.
example.traditional: 忠誠係建立信任嘅基礎。
example.jyutping: zung1 sing4 hai6 gin3 laap6 seon3 jam6 ge3 gei1 co2

rows.note: Use this for the measurable degree of loyalty, especially in contexts such as brand or customer loyalty.

example.english: This program can increase customer loyalty.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃可以提高客戶嘅忠誠度。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ho2 ji5 tai4 gou1 haak3 wu6 ge3 zung1 sing4 dou6
